# BigBear.ai to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 27, 2026


October 9, 2026 • 4:15 PM EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_44435d5418a8c753d82a3527f5edbe34/bigbear/news/2026-10-09_BigBear_ai_to_Report_Third_Quarter_2026_Results_148.pdf)


MCLEAN, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- BigBear.ai (NYSE: BBAI), a specialized security and defense technology company providing mission-ready AI for national security and trade & travel customers, today announced that it will publish its third quarter earnings release on Tuesday, October 27 at approximately 4:15 pm ET and will host an earnings call at 4:30 pm ET. The earnings release will be accessible on the Company’s investor relations website:[https://ir.bigbear.ai](https://ir.bigbear.ai/) . Additional details on the earnings call will be made available on the investor relations website on October 27, 2026.


**About BigBear.ai**


BigBear.ai is a specialized security and defense technology company providing mission-ready AI. Focused on National Security and Trade & Travel, we build and deploy AI-powered technology, solutions, and services to deliver enduring strategic advantage for the United States, its allies and partners, and critical industries. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, BigBear.ai is a public company traded on the NYSE under the symbol BBAI. For more information, visit[https://bigbear.ai](https://bigbear.ai/) .
